messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate observed for control-plane gateway (svc=ctrl-gateway) — 502/504 spike, throttles. Affected endpoints: /v1/auth/lookup, /v1/orgs/*, /v1/billing/charge. P95 latency up 4x. Paging @ryan_oncall and @sophie.
maya: seeing lots of 502s in the prod-gateway logs, started at ~16:05 UTC. Dashboards show org-lookup downstream 5xx increasing.
ryan_oncall: I'm on it. Triage steps: confirm extent, check recent deploys, smokes.
sophie: confirming deploys: no control-plane deploys in last 6h. There was a config push to org-lookup feature flags at 15:58 (PR #4432).
dennis: curl check to health endpoints: `curl -I https://ctrl-gateway.redwood.com/health` returns 200, but proxying to /v1/orgs/123 returns 502.
maya: logs (excerpt): ```2024-06-12T16:07:12Z ctrl-gateway ERROR upstream response: 502 Bad Gateway from auth-svc (connect timeout) trace=abcd1234```
infra-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/ctrl-deps-5xx. First recommended action: check auth-svc pool and org-lookup DB connections.
ryan_oncall: looking at auth-svc metrics — connection errors to auth-db spiking. DB CPU/IO looks elevated for orgdb-primary in us-west-2. Might be a DB-side issue causing timeouts upstream.
sophie: customer impact: routing shows ~12% of production traffic getting 5xx, mostly related to org enrichment flows (signup/lookup and billing attach). High-severity for webhooks and API clients in EU region.
maya: starting mitigation: enabling fallback that bypasses org-enrichment for non-critical routes via gateway feature flag. Patch: `gateway.ff.org_enrich=false --apply` (will route a simpler response).
dennis: applying flag now, pushing to 10% canary. `kubectl -n infra patch deployment ctrl-gateway -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"ff-org-enrich":"off-canary"}}}}}'`
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for ctrl-gateway ff-org-enrich=off-canary -> 10% traffic.
ryan_oncall: monitoring error rate after canary... metrics: p50 latency improved for canary pods, overall 5xx dropped from 12% -> 7% in 6 minutes. Good signal.
sophie: great. Next: isolate whether auth-svc or org-lookup DB is primary cause. Dennis, can you trigger a DB connection pool restart for auth-svc? Follow runbook step 3.
dennis: scheduling a rolling restart on auth-svc pods (graceful). `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-svc -n controlplane` — doing now.
maya: also adding temporary circuit-breaker on gateway to short-circuit calls to org-lookup after 3 timeouts (to avoid cascading retries). Config snippet: ```circuit_breaker: {threshold:3, retry_after:30s}```
infra-runbook-bot: Note: temporary CB may increase 200s with minimal enrichment, acceptable tradeoff per runbook.
deploy-bot: auth-svc pods restarting, new pods ready.
ryan_oncall: watching backend error rate — auth-svc 5xx dropped to baseline after restart. Gateway 5xx now at 3%. Looks like stale DB connections or a transient DB I/O spike caused many upstream timeouts.
sophie: confirm DB team sees I/O spike? @dennis can you share DB metrics/alerts?
dennis: DB metrics from pg-primary: write latency peaked at 16:04-16:10 and recovered after 16:14. We had a backup job overlapping with heavy traffic; backup throttling misconfigured. Filed infra ticket INFRA-789 to limit backup I/O.
maya: customer comms: posting incident update to status page: "Partial degradation for organization-related API calls starting 16:05 UTC. Mitigation in progress (fallback enabled)."
ryan_oncall: setting severity to Sev2 for tracking. Noting affected customers: two enterprise tenants ondedicated routes experiencing webhook failures. Suggest reaching out via CSMs if persistent.
sophie: handoff: @ryan_oncall will stay for next 45m, then hand to @sophie for longtail monitoring. Also adding infra-oncall to monitor backups and DB I/O throttling.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20240612-17. Timeline notes appended.
maya: post-mortem notes to collect: root cause (backup I/O + no backup-throttle), why circuit breaker not triggered earlier, why deploy/feature flag gating didn't catch it, action items: backup throttling, add DB connection health check to auth-svc, improve runbook CB thresholds, automated fallback for org-enrichment on high-latency detection.
dennis: plan to revert canary after DB fixes are in place? Suggest keep fallback in place for 2 hours then re-evaluate.
ryan_oncall: agreed. I'll escalate INFRA-789 and monitor for 2 hours. If stable, we'll remove canary and re-enable enrichment gradually.
sophie: logging: saved relevant logs to s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-20240612/ for post-mortem.
maya: final update at 17:27 UTC: 5xx rates back to baseline, canary remains for 30min, marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. Handoff to @sophie for longtail. :white_check_mark:
ryan_oncall: acknowledged handoff, will monitor until 18:15 UTC then update channel.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20240612-17 status=mitigated, severity=Sev2, owners=[ryan_oncall, sophie], timeline_url=https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-20240612-17
